description:
Bashie E Ring Bounce, revision TWO. The owner likes the motion but says the move needs four clearly separated parts: (1) Bashie throws the ring, clearly ahead of her; (2) she makes a SMALL FORWARD JUMP onto it; (3) her feet CONNECT and squash the ring; (4) she jumps HIGH. The first attempt happened almost in place and was far too quick, so it did not read as a two-part jump. This is a staging and body-mechanics revision, not uniform slow motion of the old clip.

Create KEYS ONLY for the new throw, takeoff and small-hop apex, reusing the liked old body poses for ready, plant, squash, big spring and rise. The original clip is in previous/result.json; its scripts show the anatomical arm/leg solving. The protected core poses are already retimed in keys/result.json. Copy those poses exactly at their listed ticks. No new motion/secondary pass yet.

The ring is an INDEPENDENT prop outside this Humanoid body clip. It will leave her hands and be visibly about 0.9-1.0 m AHEAD of her starting root, with its top about 0.18 m ABOVE the entry sole plane, then wait there. Her scripted small hop moves her ROOT about 0.72 m FORWARD, with a roughly 0.5 m apex, landing on that ring. The big launch follows only after compression. Those actor translations and ring transforms are applied by preview staging now, and Shared gameplay later. Do NOT put forward travel or the hop's vertical arc into Hips/root animation; pose her short legs and arms for the motion while her actor stays in place in the body file. Hips can compress for weight only.

Key clock at 60 Hz:
0 READY: COPY the old approved t0, already in keys/result.json. Hands hold the ring in front at waist height. Free entry from standing or falling.
12 THROW/RELEASE: NEW. She is still at her starting place, BEFORE the small jump. Feet on the ordinary sole plane, knees softly bent, torso leans a little forward, both hands open and extend forward at reachable waist/chest height. Read 'she threw the ring AHEAD', not 'she is already jumping on it'. No huge arm swing through her hat or face. The ring will be visibly away by tick 16. Give her eyes/chin a small forward/down intent toward the ring.
18 SMALL-HOP TAKEOFF: NEW. The automatic forward hop begins only here, AFTER the ring has been established ahead. Compact push off, heels/toes roll, short legs begin extending and the arms open/pull back for balance. A small forward lean says forward travel; this is a modest hop, not the later BOING. Its actor travel is separate.
26 SMALL-HOP APEX: NEW. Clearly airborne between the start and the ring: knees tuck the sandals up over its rim, short lower legs under/behind her, feet together enough to clear it, arms balancing forward/out. Body has a readable mild forward lean and looks down toward the waiting ring. She has NOT launched high yet. Hands/forearms stay clear of the whistle, shell, hat and thighs.
34 PLANT/CONNECT: COPY old approved t7 from keys/result.json. Both feet apart on the near padded rim, normal sole plane in body coordinates. Staging places the whole actor forward and 0.18 m higher; the ring stays there. This is the end of the SMALL hop, a distinct contact before the big bounce.
40 SQUASH: COPY old approved t10. Both soles pinned, hips about 0.08 m down. Independent ring squashes vertically.
44 BIG SPRING/BOING: COPY old approved t12. Opposite tall silhouette, arms UP/OUT beside hat, legs extend. This is where the BIG vertical recovery launches.
54 HIGH RISE: COPY old approved t18. Relaxed rising handoff. Actual high ascent is separate actor movement.

Actual proportions are authoritative: about 1 m tall, very short arms/legs, huge rigid hat/head and shell, four-finger cartoon hands. Preserve bone lengths and scales. No leg stretches to reach a distant ring: the actor translation brings her to it. Normal sole plane up=-0.305 relative entry hips; Foot about -0.184, ToeBase about -0.300. At release tick12, keep soles near their ordinary plane; no early jump/tuck. Use anatomical solvers for all new poses.

The new poses must contrast: THROW = open forward arms + feet down, SMALL HOP = forward lean + tucked knees, BIG SPRING = tall upward stretch. Do not just duplicate the same standing pose at 12/18/26, or make the small hop as energetic/tall as the big launch. The small hop and actual two-arc travel must be legible at normal speed. We will review these actual-rig keys and timed blocking with the ring before authoring transitions.
